title: Last Four Monkeys Return to ‘Monkey Farm’ in South Carolina
titleZh: 最后四只猴子回到南卡罗来纳州的'猴子农场'
credits: This story was reported by staff of the Associated Press. Jill Robbins adapted it for Learning English.

sentences.en: Officials in the southern U.S. state of South Carolina have recaptured the last of 43 monkeys who escaped from a farm that raises monkeys in early November.
sentences.zh: 美国南部南卡罗来纳州的官员们已经重新捕获了十一月初从一家猴子养殖场逃出的43只猴子中的最后一只。

sentences.en: The chief executive of Alpha Genesis research center, Greg Westergaard, said the final four recaptured monkeys appeared to be in good health.
sentences.zh: Alpha Genesis研究中心的行政总裁Greg Westergaard表示，最后被捕获的四只猴子看起来健康状况良好。

sentences.en: The remaining monkeys had spent weeks living in the woods and even experienced a rare snowstorm.
sentences.zh: 剩余的猴子已经在树林里生活了几周，甚至经历了一场罕见的暴风雪。

sentences.en: Alpha Genesis is a company that offers services to biomedical researchers.
sentences.zh: Alpha Genesis是一家为生物医学研究者提供服务的公司。

sentences.en: Some locals call it “the monkey farm."
sentences.zh: 一些当地人称它为“猴子农场”。

sentences.en: The animals – all female rhesus macaque monkeys – escaped from the grounds of the company on November 6.
sentences.zh: 这些动物——全是雌性恒河猴——于11月6日从该公司场地逃出。

sentences.en: Police who investigated the incident said the monkeys escaped when an employee did not fully secure their enclosure.
sentences.zh: 调查此事件的警方表示，由于一名员工没有将猴子的围栏完全锁好，猴子才得以逃脱。

sentences.en: Westergaard explained in November that workers were supposed to lock one gate before opening another, but all three gates were left unsecure.
sentences.zh: Westergaard在11月解释称，工人们本应先锁上一道门再打开另一道门，但三道门都未被锁好。

sentences.en: Employees at Alpha Genesis tried to persuade the monkeys to return with offers of special foods.
sentences.zh: Alpha Genesis的员工们试图用提供特别食物的方式说服猴子们回来。

sentences.en: These included peanut butter and jelly sandwiches and "monkey biscuits" – a high-protein food made specially for rhesus macaques.
sentences.zh: 这些食物包括花生酱果酱三明治和“猴子饼干”——一种专为恒河猴制作的高蛋白食物。

sentences.en: Alpha Genesis employees kept an eye on the monkeys and set out humane traps.
sentences.zh: Alpha Genesis的员工们一直留意着猴子，并设置了人道捕兽陷阱。

sentences.en: Most of the animals came back to eat the food.
sentences.zh: 大多数动物都回来进食。

sentences.en: Most of the monkeys did not go far.
sentences.zh: 大多数猴子都没有走远。

sentences.en: The animals are about the size of a cat, weighing around 3 kilograms.
sentences.zh: 这些动物体型与猫相仿，体重约3公斤。

sentences.en: The monkeys never represented a risk to public health, police and federal health officials said.
sentences.zh: 警方和联邦卫生官员表示，这些猴子从未对公共健康构成风险。

sentences.en: During the time they were free, the area received its first snow in seven years, measuring up to 8 centimeters.
sentences.zh: 在它们自由活动的这段时间里，该地区迎来了七年来第一场雪，积雪最厚达8厘米。

sentences.en: The Alpha Genesis company raises the monkeys to sell to medical labs and other researchers.
sentences.zh: Alpha Genesis公司养殖这些猴子是为了出售给医学实验室和其他研究者。

sentences.en: Humans have been using the monkeys for scientific research since the late 1800s.
sentences.zh: 自19世纪末以来，人类就开始使用这些猴子进行科学研究。

sentences.en: Scientists believe rhesus macaques and humans split from a common ancestor about 25 million years ago and share about 93 percent of the same DNA.
sentences.zh: 科学家认为，恒河猴与人类大约在2500万年前从共同祖先分化而来，并共享约93%的相同DNA。

sentences.en: I’m Jill Robbins.
sentences.zh: 我是Jill Robbins。
